node.statement: Arithmetic under the explicit added premise. Since c_0^cb>=0 and the chosen coefficient witnesses and L are at least 1, every entry in the maximum defining K_1 is finite and nonnegative and K_1>=1. Every radius in the minimum defining e_call_1 is positive: in particular c_0^cb+1>=1, L>=1, and K_1>=1, so the three denominators are positive. A finite minimum of positive universal numbers is positive and universal. Each inequality follows by comparing e_call_1 with its corresponding entry in the minimum and multiplying only by a positive denominator; K_1*e_call_1<=e_1 follows from e_call_1<=e_1/K_1.
